P.name: Iron Ambassador
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Poppy's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to throw her buckler, gaining {{sti|350 '''bonus''' range}} and dealing {{pp|20 + (180-20)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. After it hits, the buckler then falls to a location near the target over 1 second, landing and remaining there for up to 4 seconds.
P.description2: '''Poppy''' can move over the buckler to retrieve it, gaining a {{tip|shield}} for {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|key=%|11 + (20-11)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of her '''maximum''' health}}}} for 3 seconds. If the buckler kills the target, or if the target is already dead when the buckler hits it, the buckler will bounce back to '''Poppy''' instead of falling. Enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can move over the buckler to destroy it.

Q.name: Hammer Shock
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' smashes the area in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, the damage based on their health ratio is capped.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7 to 9}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Minion/Monster Health Damage|{{ap|85 to 225}}|Maximum Minion/Monster Damage|{{ap|30+85 to 130+225}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: The impact creates a field for 1 second that {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within, which then ruptures to deal the same {{as|physical damage}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 32}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.8}}% per 100 '''Poppy's bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7*2 to 9*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Maximum Minion/Monster Damage|{{ap|(30+85)*2 to (130+225)*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

W.name: Steadfast Presence
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Stubborn to a Fault:}} '''Poppy''' increases her {{sti|armor|{{as|'''total''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''total''' magic resistance}}}} by 16%, doubled to 32% while she is {{as|below 40% '''maximum''' health}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and creates an {{tip|aura}} around herself for 2 seconds, causing all enemies who attempt to {{tip|dash}} into or within it to be dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. If a target was successfully interrupted, they become {{tip|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 25% for 2 seconds.
W.description3: ''Steadfast Presence'' can only block a single dash per enemy per cast.

E.name: Heroic Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|carries}} them along with her for up to 400 units.
E.description2: If the target hits terrain, she stops to deal the same {{as|physical damage}} again and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for a duration.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} seconds}}
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

R.name: Keeper's Verdict
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' {{tip|channels|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Keeper's Verdict's'' {{sti|range}} and {{tip|airborne|knock back}} distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the channel. ''Keeper's Verdict'' can be recast within the duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Poppy''' releases the charge to launch her hammer upwards, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies nearby and in an area in front of her and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for 1 second.
R.description3: If ''Keeper's Verdict'' was charged for at least {{fd|0.5}} seconds, it deals 100% increased damage and enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} {{tt|up-to 3400 units|Scales up to this value over the first 1 second of the channel}} toward the enemy team's [[Spawn|fountain]], during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and rendered {{tip|untargetable}}. Additionally, if no enemies are hit {{tt|in front|Same as uncharged radius}} of '''Poppy''', she sends a shockwave that travels in the target direction until it collides with an enemy champion, which causes a hammer to erupt. Targets hit by the shockwave or the eruption receive the charged effects.
R.description4: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Keeper's Verdict'' is cancelled and the ability is put on a {{sti|cd|30-second}} cooldown.
